paper.title_en: Coherence transfer under bounded channel capacity
paper.abstract_en: We investigate quantum coherence transfer between two parties whose local reference bases are misaligned, under a constraint on the capacity of the quantum communication channel. Within the resource theory of coherence, we formulate the task as maximizing the coherence received by Bob when Alice is restricted to Maximally Incoherent Operations (MIO) in her local basis. We first analyze two single-shot protocols, based on direct and locally entangled transmission, and derive their phase-optimized coherence yields. We further investigate their performance when Bob's reference basis is unknown, averaging over uniformly distributed basis configurations. In the asymptotic regime, we exploit the reversibility of coherence under MIO to characterize achievable transfer rates in terms of Alice's initial coherence. For single-qubit transmission, we derive an analytical lower bound using pure-state conversions and identify a regime in which the optimal yield saturates the channel capacity.
